mechanism: Primaquine may increase risperidone levels through CYP3A4/2D6 inhibition and both drugs carry risk of QT prolongation and hemolytic effects in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for increased risperidone adverse effects including extrapyramidal symptoms and QT prolongation; obtain baseline ECG and G6PD status before primaquine use; consider dose adjustment if needed.
